name: Brik
summary: Agentic platform that turns prompts into interactive, exportable design tools for motion, 2D/3D visuals and text effects.
description: Describe a creative vision and a Brik agent builds it into an interactive, remixable design tool with sliders, toggles and inputs — no code or timelines. Tools cover kinetic typography, scroll effects, 3D and WebGL visuals, and export as images, video (including transparent) or embed/HTML.
